answers.core: There is an [add-on already actually](https://godotengine.org/asset-library/asset/53), but it is old. In my opinion, programmers in general are used to task lists, so they expect this functionality when they arrive in a new system. The task list is like a basic feature, so I think it should not be relegated to be an add-on that you have to search for.
answers.workaround: I think it will be used often, all the time actually.
